_comment: Exact versions of every external input. Two machines that use the same pins, configs, and date ranges run the same code on the same data. Bump a pin deliberately and note it in log.md.

stochastic_refinement.description: Prithvi-UNet + diffusion / flow-matching residual refinement (NARR_PRISM Phase 2: narr_prism_refinement.py, narr_prism_phase1_cache.py, evaluate_refinement.py)

weights.description: Prithvi WxC 2.3B backbone fine-tuned for downscaling; used as path_model_weights

merra2.provider: NASA GES DISC via earthaccess (HTTPS outside us-west-2)

prism.note: PRISM AN grids are revised as new station data arrive; record download dates in the run manifest.

elevation.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 public COGs regridded to the PRISM 30 arc-second grid (source grid prism_ppt_us_30s_19960101.nc)
elevation.fallback: NOAA ETOPO 2022 30 arc-second surface, bilinear to the PRISM grid. Used only when no url is pinned; not identical to the reference file, so runs using it are marked non-reproducible.
